1. (Currently amended) A packaging substrate comprising: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having at least one opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure, wherein the opening is formed by removing at least a portion of a solder mask layer to expose an underlying core layer; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to the packaging structure through a dielectric or conductive bonding agent and increases contact area and lid or ring thickness to improve package coplanarity.

2. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to a bottom surface of the opening and extends into the core layer.

3. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to a sidewall of the opening and is in contact with the core layer.

4. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface by a distance of at least 10 micrometers to provide enhanced structural support and thermal dissipation.

5. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer to expose the underlying core layer, thereby increasing the effective contact area between the stiffening microstructure and the packaging structure.

6. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 5, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a substantial portion of the core layer to allow the stiffening microstructure to bond directly to the core layer.

7. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising: an integrated circuit chip mounted on the chip mounting surface, wherein the stiffening microstructure provides mechanical support and thermal management for the integrated circuit chip.

8. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 7, wherein the stiffening microstructure includes a lid that covers at least a portion of the integrated circuit chip.

9. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 8 further comprising: a heat transfer medium providing a thermally conductive pathway between the lid and the integrated circuit chip, wherein the heat transfer medium is in direct contact with both the lid and the chip surface.

10. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is a ring disposed around a perimeter of the opening.

11. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the ground reference plane layer is in direct contact with the stiffening microstructure through the opening.

12. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a dielectric bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

13. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a conductive bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

14. (Currently amended) A computing device, comprising: a memory; and a packaged semiconductor device communicatively coupled to the memory, wherein the packaged semiconductor device comprises: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure, wherein the opening is formed by removing at least a portion of a solder mask layer to expose an underlying core layer; an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and communicatively coupled to the memory through the packaging structure; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure through a dielectric or conductive bonding agent, wherein the stiffening microstructure increases contact area and lid or ring thickness to improve package coplanarity.

15. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface and a sidewall of the opening and extends into the exposed core layer.

16. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface by a distance of at least 10 micrometers.

17. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer to expose the underlying core layer.

18. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 17, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a substantial portion of the core layer to allow direct bonding of the stiffening microstructure to the core layer.

19. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure includes at least one of a ring or a lid that provides structural support and thermal management.

20. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the stiffening microstructure is in direct contact with the ground reference plane layer through the opening.
